prayerExcerpt.en-US: The same faith and the same passion made them truly brothers.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A mesma fé e a mesma paixão os fizeram verdadeiramente irmãos.

meta.face: John (left, the elder): a man of about forty with a broad, heavy-jawed, rectangular face — a thick, straight nose, small dark eyes set close under a heavy, straight brow ridge, flat cheekbones, a wide, squared chin under the beard and a straight, firm mouth; close-cropped black hair, a short, neatly trimmed black beard and a grave, steady gaze. Paul (right): a clean-shaven man of about twenty-eight with a narrower face and a delicate, pointed chin — a small, straight nose, large light-brown eyes under high, arched brows, smooth cheeks and a soft, full mouth; short light-brown hair combed forward in a straight Roman fringe and a gentle expression. John's hair is straight and cropped, not curly.
meta.basis: The mosaic procession of martyrs at Sant'Apollinare Nuovo, Ravenna, shows both as short-haired Roman men in white pallia carrying crowns; the Breviary makes them brothers who served Constantia. The beard and age that separate John from Paul are an artistic choice.
